title: Monkey waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M70 78 Q86 78 84 62 Q82 52 74 56' fill='none' stroke='#a8682f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='19' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='88' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <ellipse cx='61' cy='88' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <!-- left arm (down) -->
    <path d='M32 62 Q20 70 22 80' fill='none' stroke='#8a4f22' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='81' r='5' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
    <path d='M68 62 Q82 55 84 42' fill='none' stroke='#8a4f22' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='40' r='6' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <!-- fingers -->
    <circle cx='81' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='23' cy='38' r='9' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <circle cx='23' cy='38' r='5' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <circle cx='77' cy='38' r='9' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <circle cx='77' cy='38' r='5' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <!-- face -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#d9a06b'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='4' fill='#3a2410'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='4' fill='#3a2410'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#f7e3c8'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#f7e3c8'/>
    <!-- nostrils -->
    <circle cx='47' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#8a4f22'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M42 51 Q50 58 58 51' fill='none' stroke='#8a4f22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
